name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  rust-tests:
    name: Rust Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Install Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        components: rustfmt, clippy
        override: true
    
    - name: Cache Rust dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cargo/registry
          ~/.cargo/git
          rust/target
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
    
    - name: Rust Format Check
      run: cd rust && cargo fmt --all -- --check
    
    - name: Rust Clippy
      run: cd rust && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
    
    - name: Rust Tests
      run: cd rust && cargo test --all
    
    - name: Run LDC Engine Automated Tests
      run: |
        cd rust/ldc-engine
        # Run regular cargo tests (automated test runner will be used when tests are fixed)
        cargo test --lib
    
    - name: Upload LDC Engine Test Reports
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: ldc-engine-test-reports
        path: rust/ldc-engine/test_reports/
        retention-days: 30

  python-tests:
    name: Python Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, 3.10, 3.11]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Cache Python dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('py/pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cd py
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e ".[dev]"
    
    - name: Python Format Check
      run: |
        cd py
        black --check .
        isort --check-only .
    
    - name: Python Lint
      run: |
        cd py
        flake8 .
        mypy .
    
    - name: Python Tests
      run: |
        cd py
        pytest tests/ -v --cov=imp --cov-report=xml
    
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        file: py/coverage.xml
        flags: python
        name: python-coverage

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [rust-tests, python-tests]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: 3.10
    
    - name: Install Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        override: true
    
    - name: Start services
      run: |
        docker-compose up -d minio redis
        sleep 10
    
    - name: Wait for services
      run: |
        timeout 60 bash -c 'until curl -f http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live; do sleep 2; done'
        timeout 60 bash -c 'until redis-cli -h localhost ping; do sleep 2; done'
    
    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        cd py
        pip install -e ".[dev]"
        pytest tests/integration/ -v -m integration
    
    - name: Cleanup
      if: always()
      run: docker-compose down -v

  build-images:
    name: Build Docker Images
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [rust-tests, python-tests]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
    
    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
    
    - name: Build and push Rust image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: ./rust
        file: ./rust/Dockerfile
        push: true
        tags: |
          ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/imp-rust:latest
          ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/imp-rust:${{ github.sha }}
    
    - name: Build and push Python image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: ./py
        file: ./py/Dockerfile
        push: true
        tags: |
          ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/imp-python:latest
          ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/imp-python:${{ github.sha }}

name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_config:
        description: 'Test configuration to use'
        required: false
        default: 'test_config.toml'
        type: string
      baseline_report:
        description: 'Baseline report for comparison (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  end-to-end-tests:
    name: End-to-End Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      
      kafka:
        image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:latest
        ports:
          - 9092:9092
        env:
          KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
          KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
          KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092
          KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
          KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: true
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"
          --health-interval 30s
          --health-timeout 10s
          --health-retries 5
      
      zookeeper:
        image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:latest
        ports:
          - 2181:2181
        env:
          ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
          ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Full history for trend analysis

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            rust/target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev

      - name: Build end-to-end test framework
        working-directory: rust
        run: |
          cargo build --release --package end-to-end-tests
          cargo build --release --bin test-runner
          cargo build --release --bin test-report-generator

      - name: Setup test environment
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          mkdir -p test-artifacts
          
          # Create test configuration if not provided
          if [ ! -f "rust/end-to-end-tests/test_config.toml" ]; then
            cat > rust/end-to-end-tests/test_config.toml << EOF
          [pipeline_tests]
          test_symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT"]
          test_duration_hours = 1
          data_interval = "5m"
          include_edge_cases = true
          validate_against_reference = false
          
          [failure_tests]
          test_hmm_failures = true
          test_redis_failures = true
          test_kafka_failures = true
          test_data_corruption = true
          failure_duration_seconds = 10
          recovery_timeout_seconds = 30
          
          [performance_tests]
          max_end_to_end_latency_ms = 100
          min_throughput_signals_per_second = 5.0
          max_memory_usage_mb = 512
          concurrent_symbols = 3
          test_duration_minutes = 2
          
          [execution]
          output_dir = "test-results"
          max_parallel_tests = 4
          test_timeout_seconds = 300
          verbose_logging = true
          
          [validation]
          feature_tolerance = 0.001
          signal_tolerance = 0.01
          performance_tolerance = 0.1
          EOF
          fi

      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for Redis..."
          timeout 60 bash -c 'until redis-cli -h localhost -p 6379 ping; do sleep 1; done'
          
          echo "Waiting for Kafka..."
          timeout 120 bash -c 'until echo "test" | timeout 5 nc -w 1 localhost 9092; do sleep 2; done'

      - name: Run end-to-end tests
        id: run_tests
        working-directory: rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          # Set test configuration
          TEST_CONFIG="${{ github.event.inputs.test_config || 'test_config.toml' }}"
          
          # Run the test suite
          echo "Running end-to-end tests with config: $TEST_CONFIG"
          cargo run --release --bin test-runner -- \
            --config "$TEST_CONFIG" \
            --output-dir "../../test-results" \
            --format json \
            --verbose
          
          # Check if tests completed successfully
          if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "test_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "test_status=failure" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Generate test reports
        if: always()
        working-directory: rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          # Generate comprehensive reports
          cargo run --release --bin test-report-generator -- \
            --input "../../test-results" \
            --output "../../test-artifacts" \
            --format both \
            --analyze
          
          # Generate CI summary
          if [ -f "../../test-results/test_report_latest.json" ]; then
            echo "Generating CI summary..."
            python3 -c "
          import json
          import sys
          
          try:
              with open('../../test-results/test_report_latest.json', 'r') as f:
                  report = json.load(f)
              
              summary = report.get('summary', {})
              print(f\"::notice title=Test Summary::Tests completed with {summary.get('overall_pass_rate', 0)*100:.1f}% pass rate\")
              
              if summary.get('critical_failures', 0) > 0:
                  print(f\"::error title=Critical Failures::{summary['critical_failures']} critical test failures detected\")
              
              if summary.get('performance_violations', 0) > 0:
                  print(f\"::warning title=Performance Issues::{summary['performance_violations']} performance violations detected\")
              
              # Set outputs for other steps
              with open('$GITHUB_OUTPUT', 'a') as f:
                  f.write(f\"pass_rate={summary.get('overall_pass_rate', 0)}\n\")
                  f.write(f\"total_tests={len([tc for suite in report.get('results', []) for tc in suite.get('test_cases', [])])}\n\")
                  f.write(f\"failed_tests={summary.get('critical_failures', 0)}\n\")
                  f.write(f\"duration_minutes={summary.get('total_duration_minutes', 0)}\n\")
          except Exception as e:
              print(f\"::error title=Report Processing Error::Failed to process test report: {e}\")
              sys.exit(1)
          "
          fi

      - name: Performance regression detection
        if: always() && github.event.inputs.baseline_report
        working-directory: rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          BASELINE_REPORT="${{ github.event.inputs.baseline_report }}"
          CURRENT_REPORT="../../test-results/test_report_latest.json"
          
          if [ -f "$CURRENT_REPORT" ] && [ -f "$BASELINE_REPORT" ]; then
            echo "Comparing against baseline: $BASELINE_REPORT"
            cargo run --release --bin test-report-generator -- \
              --input "$CURRENT_REPORT" \
              --output "../../test-artifacts" \
              --compare "$BASELINE_REPORT"
            
            # Check for regressions
            if [ -f "../../test-artifacts/comparison_report.json" ]; then
              python3 -c "
          import json
          
          with open('../../test-artifacts/comparison_report.json', 'r') as f:
              comparison = json.load(f)
          
          regressions = comparison.get('performance_regressions', [])
          if regressions:
              print(f\"::error title=Performance Regression::Detected {len(regressions)} performance regressions\")
              for reg in regressions[:3]:  # Show first 3
                  print(f\"::warning title={reg['metric_name']}::{reg['description']} ({reg['percentage_change']:.1f}% change)\")
          
          if comparison.get('pass_rate_change', 0) < -0.05:
              print(f\"::error title=Pass Rate Regression::Pass rate decreased by {abs(comparison['pass_rate_change'])*100:.1f}%\")
          "
            fi
          else
            echo "::warning title=Baseline Comparison::Baseline report not found or current report missing"
          fi

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            test-results/
            test-artifacts/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload test reports to GitHub Pages
        if: always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: test-artifacts
          destination_dir: test-reports/${{ github.run_number }}
          keep_files: true

      - name: Comment PR with test results
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const path = require('path');
            
            try {
              // Read test report if it exists
              const reportPath = 'test-results/test_report_latest.json';
              if (!fs.existsSync(reportPath)) {
                console.log('No test report found');
                return;
              }
              
              const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(reportPath, 'utf8'));
              const summary = report.summary || {};
              
              const passRate = (summary.overall_pass_rate || 0) * 100;
              const duration = summary.total_duration_minutes || 0;
              const failures = summary.critical_failures || 0;
              const perfIssues = summary.performance_violations || 0;
              
              const status = failures === 0 ? '✅' : '❌';
              const perfStatus = perfIssues === 0 ? '✅' : '⚠️';
              
              const body = `## ${status} End-to-End Test Results
              
              | Metric | Value |
              |--------|-------|
              | Pass Rate | ${passRate.toFixed(1)}% |
              | Duration | ${duration.toFixed(1)} minutes |
              | Critical Failures | ${failures} |
              | Performance Issues | ${perfIssues} ${perfStatus} |
              
              ${failures > 0 ? '### ❌ Failed Tests\n' + 
                report.results?.flatMap(suite => 
                  suite.test_cases?.filter(tc => tc.status === 'Failed')
                    .map(tc => `- \`${suite.test_suite}::${tc.name}\`: ${tc.error_message || 'Unknown error'}`)
                ).slice(0, 5).join('\n') || 'No details available' : ''}
              
              ${perfIssues > 0 ? '\n### ⚠️ Performance Issues Detected\nReview the full report for details.' : ''}
              
              [View Full Report](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})
              `;
              
              github.rest.issues.createComment({
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                body: body
              });
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Failed to create PR comment:', error);
            }

      - name: Set job status
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.run_tests.outputs.test_status }}" = "failure" ]; then
            echo "::error title=Test Execution Failed::End-to-end tests failed to complete successfully"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for critical failures
          if [ -f "test-results/test_report_latest.json" ]; then
            CRITICAL_FAILURES=$(python3 -c "
          import json
          try:
              with open('test-results/test_report_latest.json', 'r') as f:
                  report = json.load(f)
              print(report.get('summary', {}).get('critical_failures', 0))
          except:
              print(0)
          ")
            
            if [ "$CRITICAL_FAILURES" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "::error title=Critical Test Failures::$CRITICAL_FAILURES critical test failures detected"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          echo "::notice title=Tests Completed::End-to-end tests completed successfully"

  notify-failure:
    name: Notify on Failure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: end-to-end-tests
    if: failure() && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop')
    
    steps:
      - name: Notify team of test failures
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `🚨 End-to-End Tests Failed on ${context.ref.replace('refs/heads/', '')}`;
            const body = `
            End-to-end tests have failed on the ${context.ref.replace('refs/heads/', '')} branch.
            
            **Commit:** ${context.sha.substring(0, 7)}
            **Workflow:** [${context.workflow}](https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId})
            
            Please investigate and fix the failing tests.
            `;
            
            // Create an issue for tracking the failure
            github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: title,
              body: body,
              labels: ['bug', 'ci-failure', 'end-to-end-tests']
            });

FILE: .github/workflows/performance-regression.yml
================================================
name: Performance Regression Detection

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'rust/**'
      - '.github/workflows/end-to-end-tests.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/performance-regression.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      baseline_branch:
        description: 'Baseline branch for comparison'
        required: false
        default: 'main'
        type: string

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  performance-regression:
    name: Performance Regression Detection
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout current branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: current

      - name: Checkout baseline branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.baseline_branch || 'main' }}
          path: baseline

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            current/rust/target
            baseline/rust/target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-regression-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-regression-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev

      - name: Build baseline version
        working-directory: baseline/rust
        run: |
          cargo build --release --package end-to-end-tests
          cargo build --release --bin test-runner
          cargo build --release --bin ci-helper

      - name: Run baseline performance tests
        working-directory: baseline/rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p baseline-results
          
          # Generate performance test configuration
          cargo run --release --bin ci-helper -- generate-config \
            --environment performance \
            --output performance_config.toml
          
          # Run performance-focused tests
          timeout 1800 cargo run --release --bin test-runner -- \
            --config performance_config.toml \
            --output-dir baseline-results \
            --format json \
            --suite performance || echo "Baseline tests completed with issues"

      - name: Build current version
        working-directory: current/rust
        run: |
          cargo build --release --package end-to-end-tests
          cargo build --release --bin test-runner
          cargo build --release --bin ci-helper

      - name: Run current performance tests
        working-directory: current/rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p current-results
          
          # Generate performance test configuration
          cargo run --release --bin ci-helper -- generate-config \
            --environment performance \
            --output performance_config.toml
          
          # Run performance-focused tests
          timeout 1800 cargo run --release --bin test-runner -- \
            --config performance_config.toml \
            --output-dir current-results \
            --format json \
            --suite performance || echo "Current tests completed with issues"

      - name: Compare performance results
        id: compare
        working-directory: current/rust/end-to-end-tests
        run: |
          # Find the latest test reports
          BASELINE_REPORT=$(find ../../../baseline/rust/end-to-end-tests/baseline-results -name "test_report_*.json" | sort | tail -1)
          CURRENT_REPORT=$(find current-results -name "test_report_*.json" | sort | tail -1)
          
          if [ -z "$BASELINE_REPORT" ] || [ -z "$CURRENT_REPORT" ]; then
            echo "::error title=Missing Reports::Could not find baseline or current test reports"
            echo "regression_detected=unknown" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Comparing reports:"
          echo "  Baseline: $BASELINE_REPORT"
          echo "  Current: $CURRENT_REPORT"
          
          # Perform regression analysis
          mkdir -p regression-analysis
          
          cargo run --release --bin ci-helper -- check-regressions \
            --current "$CURRENT_REPORT" \
            --baseline "$BASELINE_REPORT" > regression-analysis/regression_check.log 2>&1
          
          REGRESSION_EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          # Generate detailed comparison report
          cargo run --release --bin test-report-generator -- \
            --input "$CURRENT_REPORT" \
            --output regression-analysis \
            --compare "$BASELINE_REPORT"
          
          # Set output based on regression check
          if [ $REGRESSION_EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "regression_detected=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "regression_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
          
          # Extract key metrics for reporting
          python3 -c "
          import json
          import sys
          
          try:
              with open('$CURRENT_REPORT', 'r') as f:
                  current = json.load(f)
              with open('$BASELINE_REPORT', 'r') as f:
                  baseline = json.load(f)
              
              current_pass_rate = current['summary']['overall_pass_rate'] * 100
              baseline_pass_rate = baseline['summary']['overall_pass_rate'] * 100
              pass_rate_change = current_pass_rate - baseline_pass_rate
              
              current_duration = current['summary']['total_duration_minutes']
              baseline_duration = baseline['summary']['total_duration_minutes']
              duration_change = ((current_duration - baseline_duration) / baseline_duration) * 100 if baseline_duration > 0 else 0
              
              with open('$GITHUB_OUTPUT', 'a') as f:
                  f.write(f'current_pass_rate={current_pass_rate:.1f}\n')
                  f.write(f'baseline_pass_rate={baseline_pass_rate:.1f}\n')
                  f.write(f'pass_rate_change={pass_rate_change:.1f}\n')
                  f.write(f'current_duration={current_duration:.1f}\n')
                  f.write(f'baseline_duration={baseline_duration:.1f}\n')
                  f.write(f'duration_change={duration_change:.1f}\n')
          except Exception as e:
              print(f'Error processing reports: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)
          "

      - name: Upload regression analysis artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: regression-analysis-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            current/rust/end-to-end-tests/regression-analysis/
            current/rust/end-to-end-tests/current-results/
            baseline/rust/end-to-end-tests/baseline-results/
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Comment PR with regression analysis
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            
            const regressionDetected = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.regression_detected }}';
            const currentPassRate = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.current_pass_rate }}';
            const baselinePassRate = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.baseline_pass_rate }}';
            const passRateChange = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.pass_rate_change }}';
            const currentDuration = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.current_duration }}';
            const baselineDuration = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.baseline_duration }}';
            const durationChange = '${{ steps.compare.outputs.duration_change }}';
            
            let status = '✅';
            let title = 'No Performance Regressions Detected';
            
            if (regressionDetected === 'true') {
              status = '⚠️';
              title = 'Performance Regressions Detected';
            } else if (regressionDetected === 'unknown') {
              status = '❓';
              title = 'Performance Analysis Incomplete';
            }
            
            const passRateStatus = parseFloat(passRateChange) < -5 ? '📉' : parseFloat(passRateChange) > 5 ? '📈' : '➡️';
            const durationStatus = parseFloat(durationChange) > 20 ? '🐌' : parseFloat(durationChange) < -20 ? '⚡' : '➡️';
            
            const body = `## ${status} Performance Regression Analysis
            
            ### ${title}
            
            | Metric | Baseline | Current | Change |
            |--------|----------|---------|--------|
            | Pass Rate | ${baselinePassRate}% | ${currentPassRate}% | ${passRateChange}% ${passRateStatus} |
            | Duration | ${baselineDuration} min | ${currentDuration} min | ${durationChange}% ${durationStatus} |
            
            ${regressionDetected === 'true' ? `
            ### ⚠️ Regressions Detected
            
            Performance regressions have been detected in this PR. Please review the detailed analysis in the workflow artifacts.
            
            **Action Required:**
            - Review the performance impact of your changes
            - Consider optimizations if the regression is significant
            - Update performance baselines if the change is intentional
            ` : regressionDetected === 'false' ? `
            ### ✅ Performance Impact
            
            No significant performance regressions detected. Your changes maintain or improve system performance.
            ` : `
            ### ❓ Analysis Status
            
            Performance analysis could not be completed. Please check the workflow logs for details.
            `}
            
            [View Detailed Analysis](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})
            `;
            
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: body
            });

      - name: Set workflow status
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.compare.outputs.regression_detected }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::warning title=Performance Regression::Performance regressions detected but not failing the build"
            echo "::notice title=Review Required::Please review the performance impact of your changes"
          elif [ "${{ steps.compare.outputs.regression_detected }}" = "false" ]; then
            echo "::notice title=Performance Check Passed::No significant performance regressions detected"
          else
            echo "::error title=Analysis Failed::Performance regression analysis could not be completed"
            exit 1
          fi

FILE: .github/workflows/research-environment-tests.yml
================================================
name: Research Environment Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'py/**'
      - 'notebooks/**'
      - '.github/workflows/research-environment-tests.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'py/**'
      - 'notebooks/**'
      - '.github/workflows/research-environment-tests.yml'

jobs:
  test-environment:
    name: Test Research Environment
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11']
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install dependencies
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
        pip install -e ".[dev,optimization,research]"

    - name: Validate environment
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m imp.utils.env_validator

    - name: Run unit tests
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/ -v --tb=short -m "not slow and not notebook"

    - name: Run research framework tests
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/test_research_framework.py -v

    - name: Run integration tests
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/ -v -m integration --tb=short

    - name: Check code formatting
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        black --check imp/ tests/
        isort --check-only imp/ tests/

    - name: Lint code
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        flake8 imp/ tests/ --max-line-length=88 --extend-ignore=E203,W503

  test-notebooks:
    name: Test Notebook Execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.10']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install dependencies
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
        pip install -e ".[dev,optimization,research]"

    - name: Install notebook testing tools
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pip install nbval papermill

    - name: Test notebook execution
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/test_notebook_integration.py -v -m notebook

    - name: Validate notebook outputs
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        # Run notebooks with papermill to ensure they execute
        python tests/run_research_tests.py --notebooks-only

  test-compatibility:
    name: Test Production Compatibility
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.10']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install dependencies
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
        pip install -e ".[dev,optimization,research]"

    - name: Test artifact compatibility
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/test_performance_compatibility.py -v

    - name: Test data integration
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/test_data_integration.py -v

  coverage:
    name: Code Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install dependencies
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
        pip install -e ".[dev,optimization,research]"

    - name: Run tests with coverage
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        pytest tests/ --cov=imp --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html -m "not slow"

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        file: ./py/coverage.xml
        flags: research-environment
        name: research-env-coverage

    - name: Archive coverage report
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: coverage-report
        path: ./py/htmlcov/

  documentation:
    name: Build Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'

    - name: Install dependencies
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e ".[dev,research]"
        pip install sphinx sphinx-rtd-theme

    - name: Check documentation
      working-directory: ./py
      run: |
        # Verify all documentation files exist
        test -f docs/DEVELOPMENT_SETUP.md
        test -f imp/hmm/README.md
        test -f imp/data/README.md
        test -f tests/RESEARCH_TESTING_GUIDE.md

    - name: Validate markdown
      run: |
        # Check for broken links in documentation
        find py/docs -name "*.md" -type f -exec echo "Checking {}" \;
